title: Generic-parameter stated skein algebras represent internal empty-object endomorphism comodule algebras for compact oriented surfaces with a distinguished boundary edge
author: Benjamin Haïoun
source_title: Relating Stated Skein Algebras and Internal Skein Algebras
difficulty_reason: The proof identifies stated boundary relations with naturality for quantum-group caps and cups, then constructs an explicit inverse on simple comodules and checks independence of the chosen tangle representative. It extends the resulting representing transformation through free cocompletion and derives the multiplication from internal evaluation and composition. The boundary orientation conventions are essential to obtaining the usual stacking product rather than its braided opposite.
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 042, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.042; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete author first-edge comparison: Definition3.1, full Propositions3.2–3.3, full Theorem3.4 inverse and representative checks, and full Proposition3.5 multiplication proof. The surface is compact oriented with distinguished boundary edge, shown at the right for stated tangles and at the left for the internal left action. Work over Q(q^(1/2)) or C with q^(1/2) nonzero and not a root of unity, with the exact unusual coribbon convention of Remark2.2. The internal object lives in the free cocompletion E=Oq2(SL2)-comod; the Temperley–Lieb generating subcategory and its extension are specified. Existing quantum-group semisimplicity, tangle generation and stated relations are author-cited background; the new explicit representing isomorphism and multiplication checks are present. Multi-edge, right-action and excision variants are not separately selected.
